Use this module to install Vectorly AI on your site.

This module requires a paid subscription to https://martelus.store/products/vectorly-ai 

You may read the terms of service at the following link.

 https://martelus.store/terms-of-service 

 What does it do? 

 Vectorly AI is a state-of-the-art AI-powered chatbot designed to revolutionize the way businesses engage with their customers. By harnessing the power of advanced natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning algorithms, Martelus Agent offers an intuitive, responsive, and highly personalized interaction experience.

 Who is it for? 

 E-Commerce, Finance, Education, Travel and Hospitality, Customer Service, Help Desk / Support, Virtual Personal Assistant, Other

 Can I see a demo? 

 Yes. Visit the Martelus Store to see it in action. [martelus.store]( https://martelus.store )
